SELECT count(*) n, count(DISTINCT sales_line_id) d_id, count(DISTINCT (receipt_id, line_no)) d_rl, min(sale_date), max(sale_date), count(DISTINCT etl_loaded_at) loads, min(etl_loaded_at), max(etl_loaded_at), sum(gross_amount) g
FROM fact_sales_line WHERE sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-07-25' AND DATE '2024-10-05'

SELECT date_trunc('month', sale_date) m, f.vat_rate, p.vat_class, count(*) n, sum(net_amount) net, sum(gross_amount) gross,
 round(sum(gross_amount)/sum(net_amount),4) ratio,
 sum(CASE WHEN abs(gross_amount - net_amount*(1+f.vat_rate))>0.02 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) mismatches,
 sum(CASE WHEN gross_amount IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) nullg
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
WHERE sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-08-01' AND DATE '2024-09-30'
GROUP BY 1,2,3 ORDER BY 1,2,3

SELECT s.store_id, s.region, w.status, w.dispatch_ts_utc IS NULL nodisp, date_trunc('month', f.sale_date) m,
 date_trunc('month', CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', w.dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE)) dm, count(*) n, sum(f.gross_amount) g
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key
LEFT JOIN fact_web_order w ON w.web_order_id=f.receipt_id
WHERE (f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-07-20' AND DATE '2024-10-10') AND (s.store_id>=900 OR w.web_order_id IS NOT NULL)
GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY 1,3,5,6

WITH web_dispatch AS (
  SELECT web_order_id, CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
  FROM fact_web_order WHERE status IN ('delivered','collected')
),
lines AS (
  SELECT COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date) AS business_date, s.region, p.category, s.store_id, f.gross_amount
  FROM fact_sales_line f
  JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key
  JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
  LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id=f.receipt_id
  WHERE s.store_id<>900 OR w.web_order_id IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT region, CASE WHEN store_id=999 THEN 'S999' WHEN category='ZZ Test' THEN 'ZZ' ELSE 'ok' END flag,
 sum(CASE WHEN business_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-08-01' AND DATE '2024-08-31' THEN gross_amount END) aug,
 sum(CASE WHEN business_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-09-01' AND DATE '2024-09-30' THEN gross_amount END) sep,
 count(*) n
FROM lines WHERE business_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-08-01' AND DATE '2024-09-30'
GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY 1,2

WITH web_dispatch AS (
  SELECT web_order_id, CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
  FROM fact_web_order WHERE status IN ('delivered','collected')
),
mine AS (
  SELECT date_trunc('month', COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date)) m, s.store_id, sum(f.net_amount) net
  FROM fact_sales_line f
  JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key
  JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
  LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id=f.receipt_id
  WHERE s.store_id<>999 AND p.category<>'ZZ Test' AND (s.store_id<>900 OR w.web_order_id IS NOT NULL)
    AND COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date) BETWEEN DATE '2024-08-01' AND DATE '2024-09-30'
  GROUP BY 1,2
),
ctl AS (
  SELECT date_trunc('month', business_date) m, store_id, sum(net_sales_before_returns) net
  FROM rpt_daily_store_sales WHERE business_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-08-01' AND DATE '2024-09-30' GROUP BY 1,2
)
SELECT coalesce(a.m,b.m) m, coalesce(a.store_id,b.store_id) store_id, a.net mine, b.net ctl, round(coalesce(a.net,0)-coalesce(b.net,0),2) diff
FROM mine a FULL JOIN ctl b ON a.m=b.m AND a.store_id=b.store_id
WHERE abs(coalesce(a.net,0)-coalesce(b.net,0))>0.5 ORDER BY 1,2

WITH web_dispatch AS (
  SELECT web_order_id, CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
  FROM fact_web_order WHERE status IN ('delivered','collected')
),
lines AS (
  SELECT COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date) AS business_date, s.region, f.gross_amount, f.sale_date
  FROM fact_sales_line f
  JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
  JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
  LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
  WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    AND (s.store_id <> 900 OR w.web_order_id IS NOT NULL)
)
SELECT region,
       SUM(CASE WHEN business_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-08-01' AND DATE '2024-08-31' THEN gross_amount ELSE 0 END) AS august_2024_gross_sales_incl_vat,
       SUM(CASE WHEN business_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-09-01' AND DATE '2024-09-30' THEN gross_amount ELSE 0 END) AS september_2024_gross_sales_incl_vat,
       SUM(CASE WHEN sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-08-01' AND DATE '2024-08-31' THEN gross_amount ELSE 0 END) AS aug_by_sale_date,
       SUM(CASE WHEN sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-09-01' AND DATE '2024-09-30' THEN gross_amount ELSE 0 END) AS sep_by_sale_date
FROM lines
WHERE business_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-08-01' AND DATE '2024-09-30' OR sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-08-01' AND DATE '2024-09-30'
GROUP BY region ORDER BY region
